name: Heralded amplification of telecom time-bin and Fock-state qubits with 70%-efficient MoSi SNSPDs at 2.5 K in a closed-cycle cryocooler
plain_name: Boost a fragile light-based quantum bit sent through lossy fibre using super-cold photon counters
description: All-fibre heralded qubit amplifier at 1550 nm (Bruno et al., Geneva/NIST/JPL): four MoSi superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (D1-D4) with 70% system detection efficiency, operated at 2.5 K in a two-stage closed-cycle cryocooler, register the 3- and 4-fold coincidences that herald the teleportation-based amplification.
keywords: Boost a fragile light-based quantum bit sent through lossy fibre using super-cold photon counters

sources.citation: Heralded amplification of photonic qubits (Bruno et al., arXiv:1507.03210, 2015)

requirements.rationale: The MoSi SNSPDs reach their 70% efficiency only at T < 2.5 K, so the detector stage must reach 2.5 K or below.
Each of the four nanowire detectors (D1-D4) must be current-biased and read out electrically to record the 3- and 4-fold heralding coincidences.
Optional: the detectors were designed for and operated in a two-stage closed-cycle cryocooler (no liquid-helium bath).

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
